visual_description: A large rectangular box hanging from the lab rafters. It has a high-gloss white finish and a visible intake grate with a thick, pleated paper filter behind it. A digital 'Air Quality' indicator on the side shows a green 'Good' status.

constraints.logic: Background asset that hums quietly. If it turns 'Red,' the player must change the filter.
constraints.detail: Visible vibration of the metal housing.
